authorship.scope: New standalone narration and exact mathematical companions on mixed variational systems, inf–sup stability, compatible finite elements, and Stokes preconditioning; previous manuscripts unchanged.

prerequisites.reason: The mixed Poisson equations to which stability applies.

recommended.reason: Construct a discrete counterexample and its compatible repair.
Apply the theorem to Stokes pressure.

background: Small matrix inverses, quadratic energy, a constraint multiplier, and weak-function notation.
readiness_checks: Derive and solve the stated three-by-three KKT system, then compute its Schur complement.
State separate roles of kernel coercivity and the inf–sup lower bound.

description: Examines equality-constrained minimization, saddle-point equations, Schur complements, the inf–sup constant, kernel coercivity, and the Babuška–Brezzi framework.
